turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Example: reads / Anna / books / at night. Who? Anna. Action? reads. Thing? books. Time? at night. We write: Anna reads books at night.
Rule: Write the subject first, then the verb, then the object, then place or time.
Right: Tom kicks the ball in the park. Wrong: Kicks Tom the ball in the park.
Now you try this one.
Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
